Herniated Disc (Slipped Disc) Treatment in Hyderabad

A herniated disc occurs when the soft inner portion of a spinal disc pushes through the outer layer, potentially pressing on nearby nerves. This can occur in the neck (cervical) or lower back (lumbar). Dr. B Harsha Vardhana Reddy provides comprehensive spine care at Apollo Hospitals, Financial District, Hyderabad.

Symptoms of Herniated Disc (Slipped Disc) Treatment in Hyderabad

Back or neck pain
Radiating pain
Numbness or tingling
Weakness
Pain with movement

Causes of Herniated Disc (Slipped Disc) Treatment in Hyderabad

Age-related disc degeneration

Heavy lifting with poor technique

Twisting while lifting

Trauma or injury

Repetitive strain

Genetic predisposition

Diagnosis Methods

Physical Examination

Neurological exam, provocative tests

MRI

Gold standard - shows disc and nerve compression

CT Scan

Better for bony detail

EMG

Evaluate nerve function if chronic

Frequently Asked Questions

Do herniated discs heal on their own?
Yes, many herniated discs improve over 6-12 weeks with conservative treatment. The body can reabsorb disc material. Surgery is needed in about 10-20% of cases.
Can I exercise with a herniated disc?
Yes, but avoid exercises that aggravate symptoms. Walking, swimming, and specific core exercises are usually safe. Work with a physical therapist for guidance.
